title: IOM: Nearly 730 Newly Displaced in South Kordofan's Al-Abbasiya as Abu Jubaiha Hosts Nearly 58,000
detail: The International Organization for Migration said in a report published September 3, 2026 that roughly 730 people were displaced on September 1-2 from five villages — Umm Luta, Daqaq Fur, Zarami, Al-Lubana, and Al-Saisban — in Al-Abbasiya locality, South Kordofan state, amid renewed fighting and worsening insecurity, with families fleeing to other areas within the locality and to Umm Ruwaba locality in neighboring North Kordofan. IOM described the security situation around Al-Abbasiya, where clashes intensified in late August, as remaining 'tense and volatile.' Separately, IOM said Abu Jubaiha, South Kordofan hosts nearly 57,880 displaced people across 62 sites, making it the state's second-largest displacement hub after famine-hit Kadugli, with humanitarian teams prioritizing water, sanitation, and healthcare services there as needs continue to grow. The reports add to roughly 11,000 people (2,200 families) displaced from Qaysan locality, Blue Nile state between August 28-30 after the RSF-SPLM-N alliance claimed capture of the army's Bakori and Sarkam bases.
